steps.rationale: 先通过 WalletHarness.deposit 向 accounts[actor] 存入 msg.value，写入 cumulativeDeposits[actor]，为后续 payout 提供可比较的存款基数。
在已有存款后调用 withdraw，使 WalletUser 从 Wallet 取回 amount 并增加 cumulativePayout[actor]，检验 payout 是否可能超过 cumulativeDeposits。

assumptions: WalletHarness 构造函数已创建 Wallet 与 ACCOUNT_COUNT 个 WalletUser，部署时对象存在，无需重复初始化。
deposit 与 withdraw 的 account 参数需取相同 actor（account % ACCOUNT_COUNT 相等）才能让 cumulativeDeposits 与 cumulativePayout 落在同一索引上比较。
withdraw 的 amount 需不超过 Wallet 中该 WalletUser 的 balances[msg.sender]，否则 Wallet.withdraw 的 require 会回滚；具体数值未由静态证据确定。
refund 路径未纳入本候选，因为 Wallet.refund 直接 transfer 全部余额且不更新 balances，可能使 cumulativePayout 超过 cumulativeDeposits，但该效果依赖实际余额与调用顺序，未由执行验证。
mapping 索引别名与外部调用副作用未被 Slither 完全求解，候选仅为静态可行序列，不证明属性可被违反。

data_dependencies.relation: same account index used for deposit so actor = account % ACCOUNT_COUNT matches

assumptions: ACCOUNT_COUNT is assumed to be at least 1 so account=0 maps to actor=0 in both deposit and withdraw.
deposit is payable and sends msg.value to accounts[actor].deposit; 1e18 wei is used as a concrete deposit amount.
withdraw amount is set equal to the deposited amount so the WalletUser has sufficient balance; cumulativePayout[0] increases by the actual balance delta of accounts[0].
No event reference is needed because withdraw does not depend on an object ID produced by deposit; only the account index is reused.
The property may be violated if the WalletUser refund logic returns more than deposited; this sequence is a conservative probe and execution is not claimed verified.
